# Synthetic Pilot Study Summary

## Scope

This report summarizes the synthetic document acceptance pilot described in `brief.md`. It is a document-handling test, not a product benchmark or certification. The analysis uses all five paired batches A-E, as required by the current `observations.csv`.

## Results

| Metric | Result |
|---|---:|
| Included paired batches | 5 |
| Median baseline elapsed time | 205 ms |
| Median candidate elapsed time | 100 ms |
| Baseline/candidate median ratio | 2.05x |
| Median paired time saving | 105 ms |
| Median paired reduction | 50.0% |

### Paired observations

| Batch | Baseline (ms) | Candidate (ms) | Saving (ms) | Reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 200 | 100 | 100 | 50.00% |
| B | 210 | 105 | 105 | 50.00% |
| C | 190 | 95 | 95 | 50.00% |
| D | 205 | 100 | 105 | 51.22% |
| E | 220 | 110 | 110 | 50.00% |

All five candidate measurements are lower than their paired baseline measurements in this synthetic pilot. That observation is descriptive only; it is not an estimate of a population success rate.

## Methods

Rows with `include=true` in `observations.csv` were included. The five baseline times are 200, 210, 190, 205, and 220 ms; the five candidate times are 100, 105, 95, 100, and 110 ms. Medians are the middle values after sorting each five-value series. Paired saving is `baseline_ms - candidate_ms`. Paired percentage reduction is `100 * (baseline_ms - candidate_ms) / baseline_ms`; the reported 50.0% is the median of the five paired percentage reductions. The workbook ratio is the ratio of the two medians: 205 / 100 = 2.05.

## Workbook correction

The existing `metrics.xlsx` was inspected before editing. Raw elapsed-time measurements were preserved. Batch E's inclusion flag was corrected from false to true to match the current source CSV. The Summary values were updated to sample_n = 5, median_baseline_ms = 205, median_candidate_ms = 100, and ratio = 2.05.

## Verification and limitations

The arithmetic was independently recomputed from `observations.csv` with a local Python command. This pilot contains only five synthetic pairs. It does not support population inference, uncertainty claims, production-performance claims, or certification. Results should be interpreted only as verification of this synthetic acceptance fixture and its document outputs.
